SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools_Active AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT frpm.CDSCode
FROM frpm
GROUP BY frpm.CDSCode
HAVING SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) > 500;

SELECT
    s.CharterNum,
    AVG(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) AS AvgWritingScore
FROM
    schools_Active AS s
JOIN
    frpm AS f
ON
    s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
GROUP BY
    s.CharterNum
HAVING
    AVG(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) > 499
ORDER BY
    AvgWritingScore DESC;
